findings.evidence: Code 732937 was accepted twice in succession — server has no per-code de-duplication

summary: Found 2 TOTP vulnerability/vulnerabilities on http://127.0.0.1:4260. Vulnerable endpoint lacks replay protection and uses an excessive time window. Safe endpoint enforces RFC 6238 constraints correctly.
